root.label: Andy Burnham proposes ending pension triple lock in 2030

events.label: Andy Burnham proposes ending pension triple lock in 2030

slots.name: triple lock end year
slots.sentence: In his conference speech on Tuesday, Burnham set out plans to end the existing triple lock from 2030, so the state pension increases at least by inflation or 2.5% - but remove the automatic annual link with average earnings.
